executor_profile: User-selected Luna session; no automatic model escalation

baseline.public_snapshot_warning: Accepted historical receipts, not a fresh leaderboard/rank/quota claim

execution_preset.authority_note: Research now runs no experiments. Future master prompt retains original V3 submission authorization, with live limits and inherited campaign budget. No approval per internal milestone.
execution_preset.no_fit_after_deadline: Only a user-selected hard deadline or real resource limit; default is complete declared queue.
execution_preset.preset_stage_policy: Process all45 conditional cards in one Luna chat. First24 are priority only, not a stop point. Keep controls fixed. No Sol/user review per ID. Then profile-specific full-six selection, qualified full-Train inference/submission, QA and consolidated report.
execution_preset.family_budget_scope: task+family; at most2 pilot configurations per task-family
execution_preset.atomic_card_admission: Reserve all predictor fits for a card before it starts. If remaining cap is insufficient, SKIP_BUDGET and do not start partial card.
execution_preset.RAM_policy: Estimated additional RAM <= available_RAM minus2GiB and job cap; no dense full-word matrices.
execution_preset.fit_deadline_policy: No arbitrary wall stop by default. Checkpoint at8h and continue if healthy.15min single-fit soft limit: investigate/gracefully interrupt owned job if genuinely stuck or resource bound, preserve attempt.
execution_preset.auto_selection_order: Never mix profile gains. Per task: top2 passing STANDARD cards by common W1+W4/H12 metrics; separately top1 passing LATE card by common W4+W6/H12_L. CACHE_SIX cards already have common full-six. All finalists compared only after fixed full-six. Prefer distinct families within each profile.
execution_preset.orchestra: User-selected Luna MAIN may delegate configured Luna XHigh workers under applicable orchestra policy; independent ownership; one training slot; MAIN owns integration/Git/Kaggle.

advancement_by_profile.STANDARD: top2 per task on common W1+W4/H12
advancement_by_profile.LATE: top1 per task separately on common W4+W6/H12_L
advancement_by_profile.CACHE_SIX: already common full-six; no continuation refit

execution_preset.resource_capped_optional_mode: Only if user chooses explicit hard wall deadline; checkpoint at that deadline. Default processes declared queue to end.

LATE.warning: W4+W6 is not W1+W4 or full-six primary. Remaining origins follow the card fixed support/fallback rule before any continuation.

evaluation.late_gate_note: Apply same aggregate delta thresholds to explicitly labelled W4+W6 and H12_L; report early fallback separately. No external promotion from late-only pilot. No downgrading gates after scores.
evaluation.support_groups: entry_friction0/1, stream present/missing, target tails for Regression, per-class and fit-defined text_load quartiles for Classification; unknown category status descriptive with denominators
evaluation.validation_status: All Train outcomes repeatedly reused. Temporal development evidence, not untouched holdouts; no public-score selection.
